parameters.query:
INSERT INTO contacts (phone, display_name, contact_type, notes, last_active)
VALUES ($1, NULLIF($2, ''), 'client', $3, NOW())
ON CONFLICT (phone) DO UPDATE SET
  last_active  = NOW(),
  display_name = COALESCE(contacts.display_name, EXCLUDED.display_name),
  -- keep your own friend/family classification; everyone else who books is a client
  contact_type = CASE WHEN contacts.contact_type IN ('friend','family')
                      THEN contacts.contact_type ELSE 'client' END,
  notes        = RIGHT(COALESCE(contacts.notes || E'\n', '') || EXCLUDED.notes, 1500)
RETURNING id, is_blocked;
